policy: Crop, downsize and compress only. Originals unchanged; no invented pixels or colour changes.
layout_rule: Preserve each image's aspect ratio; do not apply another cover crop that clips decorations.

photos.alt: An orange cake with white floral piping, green trim and a tall peacock feather decoration.
photos.suggested_use: Portrait gallery; keep the full visible feather in frame.
photos.limitation: Patterned seating remains behind the feather; its upper edge was already clipped in the source.

photos.alt: A white-frosted round cake decorated with burgundy bows, pink pearl shapes and piped loops.
photos.suggested_use: Strongest candidate for a prototype feature image or menu card.
photos.limitation: Original frosting texture, lighting and table setting are retained.

photos.alt: A round cake with white piped swirls, red cherries, colourful sprinkles and textured sides.
photos.suggested_use: Close-up menu card; preserve the native crop instead of another cover crop.
photos.limitation: Some top cherries were already clipped in the source; a small background object remains.

photos.alt: A doll cake with a pink-and-white piped dress and small gold-coloured decorations.
photos.suggested_use: Portrait custom-design example, not a wide hero.
photos.limitation: The dress base was already clipped in the source; some household background remains.

photos.alt: A white-frosted celebration cake with butterfly decorations, red cherries and a piped message.
photos.suggested_use: Celebration/menu card with topper and cake board visible.
photos.limitation: Existing lettering is unchanged; no flavour is inferred from its appearance.

photos.alt: A white cake with rainbow-coloured piped arcs, sprinkles and a large multicoloured butterfly topper.
photos.suggested_use: Past-bake notebook; preserve the full butterfly and gold board.
photos.limitation: Original lighting and table setting retained; no flavour or ingredient is inferred.

photos.alt: A purple drip cake with pale swirls, colourful butterflies, sprinkles and a Happy Birthday topper.
photos.suggested_use: Past-bake notebook; keep the complete birthday topper visible.
photos.limitation: The lower cake board and a small part of the base were already clipped in the export image; no missing detail is reconstructed.

photos.alt: A round white cake with golden-coloured drips, white piped swirls, sprinkles and amber-coloured pieces on top.
photos.suggested_use: Past-bake notebook; keep all visible swirls and the round board.
photos.limitation: The visual name describes colour and decoration, not a confirmed flavour.

photos.alt: A white-frosted round cake covered in dark curls, with red cherries on tall white piped swirls.
photos.suggested_use: Past-bake notebook; retain every visible cherry and the cake base.
photos.limitation: Original kitchen background and lighting remain in the full photo; the design name does not promise a flavour.

photos.alt: A golden-coloured drip cake with pink-and-white piped swirls, silver-coloured pearls and amber-coloured decorations.
photos.suggested_use: Past-bake notebook; preserve the tall central decoration and all swirls.
photos.limitation: The visual name describes the decoration, not a confirmed flavour or edible-decoration guarantee.

photos.alt: A dark-topped drip cake with pale piped swirls, silver-coloured pearls and a pink rose with green leaves.
photos.suggested_use: Past-bake notebook; preserve the complete visible rose and leaves.
photos.limitation: The lower edge of the cake and board was already clipped in the source; no missing detail is reconstructed.

photos.alt: A white cake with yellow drips, lavender-and-white piped swirls, metallic-coloured pearls and a celebration message.
photos.suggested_use: Past-bake notebook; retain the original visible decoration and lettering.
photos.limitation: A few swirls at the upper image edge were already clipped in the source; they are not reconstructed.

photos.alt: Two owner-identified tea cakes, one round and one heart-shaped, photographed together.
photos.suggested_use: Owner-selected Tea cakes cover; preserve both real cakes as one photographed example.
photos.limitation: Full source framing and RGB are retained. Original newspaper/background must be excluded only in a separate alpha derivative. No flavour is inferred. Generated cutouts require visual review.

photos.alt: An owner-identified assortment of chocolates in heart, flower, cupcake and small figure shapes.
photos.suggested_use: Owner-selected Chocolates cover; preserve visible pieces and the original source clipping.
photos.limitation: Some pieces meet or extend beyond the source edges; never reconstruct them. Full source RGB is retained. Generated cutouts require visual review, particularly removal of the tray and paper between pieces.

photos.alt: A white celebration cake with pink, blue and white piping, gold-coloured hearts and its original Happy Anniversary topper.
photos.suggested_use: Owner-selected Birthday Cakes cover; category is assigned by the owner, not inferred from the topper.
photos.limitation: Keep the original topper, initials, colours and already-clipped edges. No lettering or missing detail is rewritten. Generated cutouts require visual review.
